question: In a certain code language, ‘ENOUGH’ is written as ‘64’ and ‘PAIR’ is written as ‘40’.How will ‘FOCUS’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9f2222d13f0d75477f5789fe34c986626f9d54f937ee85ec5f0db5452d8cd8.png] 

The pattern followed here is: **Sum of positional values of all the letters - Number of letters in the word**

‘ENOUGH’ is written as &
